reply.markdown: Reply in Markdown. For each question you want to update, write one block:
reply.placeholder: <the final answer, in the same language I used>
reply.reasonPlaceholder: <why this amount, in the same language I used>
reply.exactIds: Use the exact IDs in square brackets.
reply.onlyUpdated: Only include questions you are updating.
reply.noTranslation: Do not translate my answers. Do not add F/A/U labels.
reply.amounts: For amount questions ({{keys}}), use "### {{amount}}" and "### {{reason}}" under the heading.
reply.json: Reply in JSON in the form of example: one item in answers for each question you want to update, with its exact id and the final answer as text, in the same language I used. Only include questions you are updating. Do not translate my answers. Do not add F/A/U labels.
reply.jsonAmounts: For amount questions ({{keys}}), give amount as a number and reason instead of text.

export.title: Export for AI
export.then: Next: paste into your AI, then
export.noQuestions: Choose at least one section with a question to answer
export.noQuestionsPlan: Choose at least one item with a question to answer

import.title: Import from AI
import.replyPlaceholder: Paste the reply in Markdown or JSON
import.tooLong: This is too long. Import fewer questions at a time.
import.unreadableFile: Couldn't read this file. Use a .md or .json file in UTF-8.
import.expected: Write each answer under its question ID, like this:

match.unknownId: No question {{id}} here. Choose one, or it is discarded.
match.unmatched: Choose a question, or it is discarded.
match.outOfScope: Not in this import. Choose a question, or it is discarded.
match.notImportable: Tables and numbers can't be imported
match.duplicate: Another block is for this question too. Keep one.
match.emptyFor: Nothing in this block for that question
match.question: Question for {{block}}
match.duplicates: Keep one block for each question to go on.

review.toApplyFau: to apply. Changed answers go back to Unclassified so you can check them.
review.applyFirst: Apply first, then attach evidence in the question
review.noChangesBody: The reply holds the answers as they are now.
review.note: Each change is saved in history as an AI import.
review.conflict: Some answers changed while you were reviewing
review.questionsChanged: Some questions can no longer be imported. Uncheck them and apply again.
review.gone: This question is no longer in the template
